Container.Name: OpenPronounce
Container.Overview: Self-hosted phoneme-level pronunciation assessment with a web UI and versioned REST API. This GPU template is tuned for an NVIDIA GTX 1080 Ti and persists downloaded speech models and Piper voices in appdata.
Container.Requires: The Unraid NVIDIA Driver plugin and a working NVIDIA container runtime are required. The first start downloads several gigabytes of models to appdata.

Config.Name: Web/API Port
Config.Description: Web UI, OpenAPI docs, and REST API port.

Config.Name: Persistent Configuration
Config.Description: Hugging Face models, Piper voices, and synthesized reference cache.

Config.Name: API Key
Config.Description: Optional shared secret. Clients may send X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer. Recommended outside a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU
Config.Description: Use all, a GPU index such as 0, or a GPU UUID from nvidia-smi -L.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: Capabilities required for CUDA inference and GPU status.

Config.Name: Torch Device
Config.Description: cuda for the selected NVIDIA GPU; use cpu only with a CPU-compatible image.

Config.Name: Preload Models
Config.Description: Download and load the default English models in the background at startup.

Config.Name: Maximum Concurrent Analyses
Config.Description: Keep at 1 for an 11 GB GTX 1080 Ti to avoid transient CUDA out-of-memory errors.

Config.Name: Maximum Upload MB
Config.Description: Reject larger audio uploads before decoding.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated browser origins. Leave blank unless a separate web app calls this API.

Config.Name: TTS Engine
Config.Description: Piper runs locally after the first voice download.

Config.Name: Piper Voice
Config.Description: Default offline reference voice. Change this with the language when needed.
